title: Zebra Growth Playground — Eric with Rana Dajani (We Love Reading founder) on regenerative growth in the age of AI
summary: Zebra Growth — the Amsterdam-based regenerative-growth studio — hosts a free online 'Playground' pairing Eric with Rana Dajani, the Jordanian molecular biologist who founded We Love Reading (now in 70+ countries reaching close to half a million children). Moderated by Zebra's Moh Al-Haifi.
blockquote: Join Eric Ries, author of The Lean Startup and Incorruptible, and Rana Dajani, scientist, social entrepreneur and founder of We Love Reading, for a timely conversation about the future of growth.
attribution_title: Regenerative-growth studio; hosts of the Playground series
